goal: Implementar a Engine Reativa de Confirmações de Blockchain com suporte a Reorganizações de Rede (Reorgs em src/blockTree.ts e src/reorgEngine.ts), alertas bidirecionais (CONFIRMED/REORG_REVOKED), poda de órfãos (Zero-OOM), persistência e recuperação por snapshot determinístico, idempotência estrita e re-exportações em src/index.ts.

types.name: BlockHeader
types.shape: { readonly hash: string; readonly prevHash: string; readonly height: number; readonly txids: readonly string[]; readonly timestampMs: bigint; }

types.name: ReorgResult
types.shape: { readonly isReorg: boolean; readonly commonAncestorHash: string | null; readonly disconnected: readonly BlockHeader[]; readonly connected: readonly BlockHeader[]; readonly activeTip: BlockHeader; }

types.name: AlertEvent
types.shape: { readonly eventId: string; readonly type: AlertEventType; readonly subscriptionId: string; readonly txid: string; readonly userId: string; readonly blockHash: string; readonly blockHeight: number; readonly currentConfirmations: number; readonly threshold: number; readonly timestampMs: bigint; }

types.name: SubscriptionState
types.shape: { readonly subscriptionId: string; readonly txid: string; readonly userId: string; readonly threshold: number; readonly isAlerted: boolean; readonly lastAlertedHeight: number; }

types.name: EngineBlockResult
types.shape: { readonly blockHash: string; readonly blockHeight: number; readonly isReorg: boolean; readonly reorgDetails?: ReorgResult; readonly alerts: readonly AlertEvent[]; }

types.name: EngineBatchResult
types.shape: { readonly processedCount: number; readonly committedCount: number; readonly rejectedCount: number; readonly abortedCount: number; readonly totalAlerts: number; readonly executionDigest: bigint; readonly blockResults: readonly EngineBlockResult[]; }

types.name: EngineSnapshot
types.shape: { readonly treeSnapshot: { readonly blocks: Record<string, BlockHeader>; readonly tipHash: string | null; readonly tipHeight: number }; readonly subscriptions: Record<string, { readonly subscriptionId: string; readonly txid: string; readonly userId: string; readonly threshold: number; readonly isAlerted: boolean; readonly lastAlertedHeight: number }>; readonly txToBlockMap: Record<string, { readonly blockHash: string; readonly height: number }>; readonly canonicalHeightToHash: Record<number, string>; readonly totalAlertsEmitted: bigint; readonly lastProcessedMs: bigint; readonly eventSequence: bigint; }

methods.name: snapshot
methods.returns: { readonly blocks: Record<string, BlockHeader>; readonly tipHash: string | null; readonly tipHeight: number }

params.name: snap
params.type: { readonly blocks: Record<string, BlockHeader>; readonly tipHash: string | null; readonly tipHeight: number }

prelude: const engine = new ReorgEngine();
__targetInstance = engine;
__failingCall = () => engine.processBatch([{ hash: '', prevHash: '', height: 0, txids: [], timestampMs: 100n }], 100n);
